title: Make DefiLlama stablecoin context metrics snapshot-coherent
instructions: Verified on exact base_sha: build_stablecoin_context() in handoff.py lines 121-147 selects latest by (asset, metric) independently. The DefiLlama parser omits observations for missing price/prevDay, so a later same-day supply-only revision inherits old price/change and falsely raises peg_price_coverage/change_coverage. Implement a small, deterministic correction: choose the newest PIT-visible component_supply_usd row per symbol as snapshot anchor; include component_price_usd and component_supply_change_{1d,7d,30d}_usd ONLY when their rows match the anchor's asset, source, effective_at_ms, available_at_ms, observed_at_ms, revision and provenance.stablecoin_id when present. Do not forward-fill metrics across snapshots; missing remains None and coverage decreases. Keep component shape, ordering, raw/audit separation, context_only and frozen scoring intact; do not alter providers, normalization, or any other files. Add exactly one focused unittest in test_v1_handoff.py named test_stablecoin_context_snapshot_coherence_v3: use DefiLlamaStablecoinCompositionCollector.parse_payload on TWO DISTINCT payloads, each with exactly ONE USDT (id '2') row. Earlier observed_at_ms=1787520000000 payload has circulating.peggedUSD=1000, circulatingPrevDay.peggedUSD=950, price=1.001; later observed_at_ms=1787520500000 payload has circulating.peggedUSD=1200, omits circulatingPrevDay and price. Combine observation lists. At earlier as_of assert tracked_supply_usd=1000, component price_usd=1.001, change_1d_usd=50, peg_price_coverage=1 and change_coverage['1d']=1. At later as_of assert tracked_supply_usd=1200, component price_usd/change_1d_usd/peg_deviation_bps are None, missing_fields contains price_usd and change_1d_usd, peg_price_coverage=0, change_coverage['1d']=0, weighted_abs_peg_deviation_bps and tracked_change_1d_usd are None. Also assert _scoring_history(combined)==[] and earlier as_of never sees later supply. No duplicate symbol rows inside one payload. IMPORTANT: prior v2 executor failed on git diff --check exit 2, which Git uses for whitespace errors; runner setup succeeded and logs do not establish infrastructure failure. Make the smallest whitespace-clean patch, avoid trailing spaces/blank-line whitespace and conflict markers, run git diff --check after edits, inspect/fix its diagnostics if nonzero, never bypass/disable the whitespace safety gate. Run focused and full Capital Flow pytest. If whitespace gate still cannot pass, report concrete diagnostics as BLOCKED rather than silently retrying.

executor_result.summary: Implement snapshot-coherent DefiLlama stablecoin context metrics in handoff.py and add test_stablecoin_context_snapshot_coherence_v3 in test_v1_handoff.py without whitespace violations.
